title: Superfluid Stiffness and Nonclassical Rotational Inertia of the Dilute Hard-Sphere Bose Gas
summary: We study the three-dimensional Bose gas of hard spheres of diameter $a$ at density $\rho$ and temperature $T$, in the thermodynamic limit with $a$, $\rho$, and $T$ fixed. When the gas parameter $\rho a^3$ is sufficiently small and $0 0$ depends only on the container and the axis. In both results the derivative of the free energy is taken at finite volume, before the thermodynamic limit. The temperature $T_*$ is of order $(\rho a^3)^{1/3}/\log(1/(\rho a^3))$ times the critical temperature of the ideal Bose gas.
